natural_input.description: Algorithm dataflow for stable softmax. Only X, Reduce Max, Subtract, Exponential, Reduce Sum, Divide, Y. X is a vector N; m=max_i X_i; Z_i=X_i-m; E_i=exp(Z_i); s=sum_i E_i; Y_i=E_i/s. Both X and Reduce Max feed Subtract, Exponential feeds both Reduce Sum and Divide, and Reduce Sum also feeds Divide. Divide produces Y. No hardware mapping.
